# EduProSuite

> EduProSuite (https://eduprosuite.pro/) is an educational platform and professional licensing hub providing rigorous, formula-verified test simulators, interactive digital practice exams, printable quick-review cheat sheets, and comprehensive study vaults across STEM college preparation, skilled trades, finance & accounting, and professional healthcare credentials.

## Free Interactive Mock Exam Simulators
- [AP Statistics Master Simulator](https://eduprosuite.pro/mock-test-ap-stats.html): 40-question timed practice exam with instant feedback, formula rationale, and AP scoring distribution.
- [EPA Section 608 Universal Exam Simulator](https://eduprosuite.pro/mock-test-epa608.html): 100-question practice test covering Core, Type I (Small Appliances), Type II (High Pressure), and Type III (Low Pressure).
- [Journeyman Plumber Exam Simulator](https://eduprosuite.pro/mock-test-plumber.html): IPC/UPC code questions, pipe sizing, fixture units, venting formulas, and drainage slope calculations.
- [Journeyman Electrician NEC Simulator](https://eduprosuite.pro/mock-test-electrician.html): National Electrical Code (NEC) load calculations, conduit fill, motor circuits, and box sizing.

## Quick-Review Cheat Sheets & Formula Guides
- [AP Statistics Quick Review Sheet](https://eduprosuite.pro/review-sheet-ap-stats.html): Essential probability formulas, sampling distributions, hypothesis test test-statistics, and inference conditions.
- [AP Calculus Quick Review Sheet](https://eduprosuite.pro/review-sheet-ap-calc.html): Derivatives, integral rules, chain rule, fundamental theorem of calculus, and series convergence tests.
- [Trade Math Formula Cheat Sheet](https://eduprosuite.pro/review-sheet-trade-math.html): Pipe rolling offsets, bend multipliers, hydraulic pressure, and volume calculations.
- [AP Statistics Digital Flashcards](https://eduprosuite.pro/flashcards-ap-stats.html): Interactive digital flashcards covering terms, standard error formulas, and Type I/II errors.

## Technical Knowledge Base & Glossary
- [CDL Air Brake Slack Adjusters & Pushrod Stroke](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-air-brakes-slack-adjuster.html): FMCSA stroke limits, automatic vs manual adjusters, and pre-trip inspection steps.
- [Conduit Bending Multipliers & Offset Formulas](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-conduit-bending-multipliers.html): NEC conduit bending multipliers for 10°, 22.5°, 30°, 45°, and 60° bends.
- [The Chain Rule in Calculus: Formulas & Worked Examples](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-derivatives-chain-rule.html): Step-by-step calculus chain rule proofs, composite functions, and Leibniz notation.
- [Fiduciary Duty vs Suitability Standard](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-fiduciary-vs-suitability.html): SEC Regulation Best Interest (Reg BI) vs FINRA Rule 2111 suitability guidelines.
- [GAAP vs IFRS: Depreciation, Inventory & Leases](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-gaap-vs-ifrs-depreciation.html): FASB vs IASB accounting divergence for LIFO/FIFO, component depreciation, and asset impairment.
- [HACCP Temperature Danger Zone (41°F - 135°F)](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-haccp-temperature-danger-zone.html): ServSafe food safety temperatures, two-stage cooling rules, and bacterial growth limits.
- [Mechanic's Liens for General Contractors](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-mechanics-lien-contractors.html): Preliminary notice statutory deadlines, perfecting a lien, and foreclosure compliance.
- [P-Value in Hypothesis Testing](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-p-value-hypothesis-testing.html): Interpretation of statistical significance, alpha thresholds, and common misconceptions.
- [EPA 608 Refrigerant Recovery & Leak Rates](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-section-608-refrigerants.html): Clean Air Act Section 608 trigger rates for commercial refrigeration and industrial process equipment.
- [Type I vs Type II Errors in Statistics](https://eduprosuite.pro/glossary-type-i-type-ii-errors.html): Alpha (false positive), Beta (false negative), and statistical power calculations.
